title: ContextualLoot catalog
description: Leveled lists whose entries depend on the situation (player level, chance, Daily Ops progress, known plans, equipped ammo), used for Daily Ops rewards and kill drops.
x-help:
Fallout 76 leveled lists can test conditions on each entry, which Fallout 4 lists cannot. Tales rolls the lists in this catalog itself so those conditions still apply.

Lists are the conditional lists. Each list has entries (an item or another list, with a count, a minimum level and a chance of nothing) and each entry or list can carry conditions. Ammo groups gather the ammo types that share a keyword, so an 'ammo' condition can ask whether the equipped weapon uses that ammo. Rewards pay experience and leveled-list items per row of the Daily Ops reward screen. Tokens are items that, when found on a kill, make the game roll one of the lists instead of a death item. Counts override how many items a list entry gives at a certain level.

A condition compares a value to a number: choose what to measure (player level, a random 0-100, whether a double mutation was done and so on), the comparison, and the number. Tick 'or next' to join a condition to the one after it with OR; otherwise conditions are joined with AND.

f.title: Measure
f.description: What is compared with the number.

x-enum-labels.prior: Daily Ops tier already unlocked (1 yes, 0 no)
x-enum-labels.within: Run finished within a tier's time (1 yes, 0 no)
x-enum-labels.plan: Plan in this entry already learned (1 yes, 0 no)
x-enum-labels.ammo: Equipped weapon uses this ammo group (1 yes, 0 no)

op.title: Comparison
op.description: How the measure is compared with the number.

value.title: Number
value.description: The number the measure is compared with.

or.title: Or next
or.description: Join this condition to the next with OR instead of AND.

x.title: Fixed number
x.description: The number used by a 'fixed number' measure.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Which Daily Ops tier a 'prior' or 'within' measure looks at.

keyword.title: Ammo group keyword
keyword.description: For an 'ammo' measure: the keyword of an entry in Ammo groups.

list.title: Another list
list.description: Roll another list from the Lists tab instead of giving an item.

level.title: Minimum level
level.description: The entry can only be chosen when the player is at least this level.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: The entry is only considered when these hold.

settings.description: Feature-wide values; a later plugin's field replaces the earlier one.

id.title: List (LVLI)
id.description: The leveled list this row rolls.

flags.title: Roll rules
flags.description: How the list picks its entries.

max.title: Maximum count
max.description: Most items the list can give. 0 means no limit.

conditions.title: List conditions
conditions.description: The whole list gives nothing unless these hold.

ammo_groups.title: Ammo groups
ammo_groups.description: Ammo types that share one keyword. An 'ammo' condition names a group by its keyword.

keyword.title: Group keyword
keyword.description: Keyword that names the group. A weapon matches when it has this keyword or its loaded ammo is in the group.

ammo.title: Ammo
ammo.description: The ammo types in the group.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.description: Daily Ops rewards: experience plus leveled-list items for each row of the reward screen.

id.title: Name
id.description: A name for the reward. Not a form.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: The reward is paid only when these hold.

items.title: Items
items.description: Leveled lists rolled for the reward.

count.title: Rolls
count.description: How many times the list is rolled.

row.title: Screen row
row.description: Which row (0 to 3) of the reward screen the result is shown in.

tokens.title: Kill-drop tokens
tokens.description: Items that stand in for a drop: when one is found on a kill, the game rolls the chosen list instead.

token.title: Token item
token.description: The placeholder item in the death list.

list.title: Death list replaced
list.description: The death list the token stands in for.

root.description: The list from the Lists tab that is rolled in its place.
root.title: List rolled

counts.title: Count overrides
counts.description: Restores a quantity in a game leveled list: the entry of the chosen list that has the chosen level gets the new count.

list.title: Game list
list.description: The game leveled list whose entry is changed.

root.title: Entry
root.description: The item or list inside that game list whose count is changed.

level.title: Entry level
level.description: Only the entry with this level is changed.

count.title: New count
count.description: The count the entry gives from now on.
